content: Board game recommenders (Quantic Foundry, Boreg, Try These Games, LogicBalls) mostly use collaborative filtering / content-based filtering on BGG data (ratings, tags, tf-idf on descriptions+mechanics+categories), not true NL preference matching. LogicBalls is the closest to NL-style prompting, returning mechanics/playtime/reasoning per match. True conversational NL recommendation is rare/differentiating in this space.
